summary: On-prem CI runner stuck in provisioning loop during KMS secret re-cipher in air-gapped cluster
description: Summary: After a scheduled KMS re-cipher (re-wrap) for customer on-prem key material, a subset of on-prem CI runners in the us-west cluster entered a repeated provisioning loop. Runners continually attempted to bootstrap, failed to fetch updated secrets from Vault via the proxy, restarted, and retried, causing a backlog on the release pipeline and blocked deploys for a small set of services. This is affecting nightly release validation jobs and some canary rollouts.
impact: Approximately 12 runner pods stuck in restart loop across two racks; ~140 queued jobs in the release pipeline; blocked canary promotion for svc-config and infra-images. No customer-facing runtime outages, but release cadence delayed and release engineering blocked from completing hotfix rollout.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger KMS re-cipher job that rotates envelope keys for on-prem Vault cluster. 2) Observe vault-agent rolling restart across bootstrap nodes. 3) Watch runner pods attempt vault read of /secret/ci/bootstrap and fail TLS handshake via the internal proxy (squid). 4) Runners crashloop with repeated re-registration attempts.
logs:
Selected runner bootstrap logs (abridged):
[2026-02-18T02:14:03Z] runner-bootstrap: fetching secret from vault://vault.internal/secret/ci/bootstrap
[2026-02-18T02:14:03Z] proxy: TLS handshake failed: unexpected EOF
[2026-02-18T02:14:03Z] runner-bootstrap: token refresh failed: 401 unauthorized
[2026-02-18T02:14:04Z] supervisor: exiting with code 1, restart in 5s
Network proxy (squid) logs: TLS session terminated, handshake error: recv failed, TLS_ALERT_BAD_CERT
Vault logs around rewrap: KMS rewrap completed for key=onprem-ci-enc, rewrapped tokens not yet available to secondary nodes for ~45s
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: tokens were rewrapped successfully but proxy TLS session/stateful behavior caused client certificate validation to fail for short window during rewrap. We observed a ~45s window where secondary vault nodes returned a different TLS cert chain leading to handshake failures through the proxy. Runners use short-lived bootstrap tokens; token refresh attempts during that window received 401 or connection resets. The combination of short TTL and the proxy not gracefully handling the cert rotation caused the rapid crashloop. Packet captures show TLS ClientHello followed by RST from proxy. Related to past incidents where KMS rewrap + proxy caused transient auth failures (see linked INT-53210).
temporary_workarounds: 1) Increased bootstrap token TTL to 10m for affected runner class via release-engineering override. 2) Manually re-injected the rewrapped secret into the vault path for the affected nodes to avoid a second re-fetch. 3) Drained and cordoned the two affected racks to avoid new jobs scheduling on unstable runners. These reduced churn and unblocked the pipeline within ~30 minutes.
action_items: 1) SRE: Update proxy (squid) to support zero-downtime cert reload and enable TLS resume across cert rotations. 2) Security/Key Ops: Add pre-warm step to KMS rewrap that updates active proxy certs before vault agent restarts. 3) Release Eng: Add runner bootstrap backoff to avoid immediate re-register loops on consecutive auth failures. 4) Infra: Add a canary run during rewrap windows to detect runner registration failures automatically.
comments: 2026-02-18T03:02:11Z - Marcus Chen: Confirmed crashloop pattern across 12 pods; collecting vault and proxy logs. Spun up a temporary vault read mirror to validate token rewrap visibility.

2026-02-18T03:45:22Z - Priya Rao (SRE): Proxy versions <3.8 show cert reload bug; bumping to 3.9 in staging for validation. Added firewall rule to allow vault agent healthcheck traffic bypass for now.
2026-02-18T04:20:05Z - Aisha Patel: Release Eng increased bootstrap token TTL and manually staged secrets; pipeline backlog reduced to 20 jobs. Marking this as P1 due to release blockage.

2026-02-20T11:12:09Z - Daniel Liu (Security): Will coordinate KMS rewrap runbook update and sign-off on the pre-warm cert step. Raising follow-up to add automated verification step to rewrap playbook.
2026-02-22T09:01:14Z - Marcus Chen: Deployed proxy 3.9 to affected racks and pushed runner backoff change (infra repo PR referenced). Monitoring for 24h before closing.
resolution_notes: Mitigation steps: bumped bootstrap token TTL temporarily, manually staged rewrapped secrets, drained affected racks, and deployed proxy 3.9 with zero-downtime cert reload. Pulled runner bootstrap to add exponential backoff on consecutive 401s and added a pre-warm cert update step to KMS rewrap runbook. Post-mortem scheduled with Security, SRE, and Release Eng to finalize runbook changes and permanent fixes. No further runner churn observed after proxy upgrade and backoff deployment. Follow-up tasks created to automate canary check and add observability alerts for bootstrap 401 spike. Linked INT-53210 for further vault rewrap hardening.
follow_up_tasks: SRE-1241: Automate proxy cert zero-downtime reload test
RE-678: Update KMS rewrap runbook to include pre-warm cert step
INFRA-342: Add exponential backoff and jitter to runner bootstrap logic
